articles.title: Nearly 300,000 at risk from Himalayan floods, as flood zone building accelerates
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: Nearly 300,000 people may live in areas at risk of flooding in the Nepalese, Indian and Chinese areas of the Himalayas. The results, from a study published in Scientific Reports, also indicate that the total area covered by buildings within potential flood zones increased by approximately 45% between 2016 and 2023.

articles.title: New stability rules distinguish quantum phases of matter that an older method wrongly groups together
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: Most of us recognize basic phases of matter and their properties: solids maintain their shape, liquids flow freely with constant volume, and gases expand to fill their container. Quantum phases, on the other hand, are much harder to categorize, overturning traditional notions of what a phase even is and forcing physicists to rethink their definitions.
